en.headline: Free harbour shows open the performing arts expo next week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Arts Development Council said outdoor performances will run at the Cultural Centre from 6 to 9 October, ahead of the expo.
body: Free outdoor performances will run on the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza from 6 to 9 October, ahead of the Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo, the Hong Kong Arts Development Council said.

The council said the prelude programmes will be staged each day from 4:30pm to 7:30pm on the harbourfront plaza. The expo itself, sponsored by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the council, is due to bring together companies and presenters over the following days, with partner programmes scheduled from 7 to 13 October and again from 16 to 18 October.

Three public ticketed performances are already on sale through URBTIX, the council said. They are My City at the Cultural Centre Studio Theatre at 8pm on 8 October, priced at HK$280 or HK$140 concession, and two shows at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre on 11 October: Paradisum at 3pm and An Isolated Case, with standard tickets at HK$280 or HK$180 and concessions at HK$140 or HK$90.

zh.headline: 演藝博覽序幕 文化中心下周二起免費演出
zh.dek: 藝發局表示，10月6日至9日每天下午4時半至7時半，在香港文化中心露天廣場有免費戶外節目。
body: 香港演藝博覽2026開幕前，序幕節目將於10月6日至9日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行。香港藝術發展局表示，節目免費，向市民及旅客開放。
藝發局指，戶外演出每日下午4時半至晚上7時半在海濱廣場進行。博覽由文化體育及旅遊局贊助、藝發局籌辦，伙伴節目安排在10月7日至13日，以及16日至18日，於多個場地舉行。
三場公開售票演出已於城市售票網發售。藝發局資料顯示，《我城》於10月8日晚上8時在文化中心劇場上演，門票280元、優惠票140元；10月11日在東九文化中心則有《天境重生 Paradisum》下午3時場，以及《純屬個別事件》，正價分別為280元及180元，優惠票140元及90元。
